phase_prompt.summary: The Narrator as the wandering witness in standard travel gear.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic medium shot of the Narrator, an ancient-tech scribe standing amidst obsidian ruins. He wears heavy, dust-colored linen robes intricately embroidered with copper circuitry patterns. His face is partially obscured by a tactical shemagh, and he wears brass-rimmed goggles with glowing crystalline lenses. A heavy, primitive-looking sensor backpack is strapped to his shoulders. He holds a dark glass tablet displaying holographic cuneiform data. The lighting is dramatic, high-contrast sunset striking the metallic threads in his clothing. Texture of worn fabric and oxidized metal is palpable.
